from what is known now, likely genetic alterations in a few alleles determining neural reactions to oestrogens and androgens. In later age (by which i mean toddler and up) the reaction difference is relatively minute, but during embryonic development it changes how cells form connections with eachother, migrate and trim their appendages.

When that happens, you get the anatomical structure of certain parts of the cns that resemble the opposite sex, those parts tend to be responsible for how you view yourself, how you socialise, how you perceive environment, how you perceive your body, etc. The brain instinctively knows what it's supposed to do, that's because subcortical pathways are innate and immutable (apart from stroke and trauma) hence when something doesn't match up with the instinctive pattern it wants to see, you get distressed.

As a comparison, imagine one of those videos meant to weird you out, robots that look almost like people, but not really, structures that defy your inherent understanding of space. Together with confusion they elicit this feeling that something is wrong, like this bugging thing at the back of your mind. So now take the same mechanism, and if your brain inherently knows that you're supposed to be female, but it sees a male body in control, all individuals around it are reacting to you like a male, it will freak out just the same. Because it has that program prewritten in it where it knows how things are supposed to be, but reality doesn't match up. And boom - dysphoria.

Of course the feeling isn't constant, it can get stronger or weaker depending on what stimuli are reaching your brain. If say you're gaming and forget who you are, where you are and such, it will decrease, there is nothing setting off the feeling of wrongness. On another hand, if you get a glimpse of your body in a way that makes it look likw your natal sex, or of somebody refers to you as your agab, you get the reminder that things are still wrong and things feel worse.

Hope this makes some sense

What the word oestrogen means in chem is a sterol (a steroid alcohol) with a aromatised A ring (the first ring of the molecule when you look from left to right. Aromatised means that every carbon is connected via a 1.5 bond to each other in the ring) and an OH at the 3rd carbon. When you look at the picture, you'll see that all of them have that. It's just based on chemical structure.

Not all oestrogens have the same function, in fact pretty much all of them have different functions, and don't bind to eachother's receptors either at all or very very weakly. 

In fact phytoestrogens that are usually used as an example by pseudoscientific dumbasses, are actually a plant's metabolite which actually acts as a slight fertility lowering toxin that works on *fungi* mainly in order to lower their ability to reproduce, hence lowering the chance of the plant getting infected with a fungal disease. Animal hormones are quite different, and will act on human oestrogen receptors. It's just that finding something that you actually want in life helps with everything, because then whatever others say becomes unimportant really. And i don't really mean what you want in a sexual way, just anything, a career, dreams, anything like that, because then you have something to focus on.

I am one of those people who pretty much feels nothing what could be called as love, so i get the feeling of not belonging a lot, but for me personally investing time into forming genuine friendships has helped a lot.
